verdict.rationale: Plausible's only event-driven automation is traffic spike notifications: when traffic spikes or drops, it automatically sends an alert. That is a fixed, built-in alert rather than general user-defined rules that trigger arbitrary actions. Scheduled email and Slack reports run on a recurring schedule, not on events, so they don't count toward this story. Missing for 10: user-definable rule conditions on custom events or goals, configurable actions beyond notifications (e.g. webhooks), documentation of threshold configuration, and independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can define rules that trigger actions automatically on events

citations.quote: Traffic spike notifications: get alerted when traffic spikes
